_readme: Gap research G1-anchors-outside-table, static, HEAD export. Scope: every key in maps-site/data/city-anchors.json (136) plus the two meshedWorldInit literals CITY_ANCHORS['Summarch']={atlasX:523,atlasY:58,...} and CITY_ANCHORS['Penthelon']={atlasX:1962,atlasY:644,...} = 138; minus the 40 names in out/anchor-correction-table.json (both literals are among them) = 98 anchors. Ring detector (enclosed-component centroid method of marker-anchor-pixel-bias): z5 tiles mosaicked with no y-flip (atlas (x,y) = z5 (2x,2y), tile floor(2x/256)), missing tiles filled rgb(198,178,128); ink = luma<100; every enclosed non-ink component is hole-filled and its centroid mapped to atlas as (i+0.5)/2. ○ = 7-9 px box, area 40-60, no dark core, circularity>=0.88; ◉ = 10-14 px box, dark core>=25 px; a candidate counts as a printed ring when >=97% of a 3 px annulus around it is ink. Calibration: Epēshu ◉ 0.05 px from its anchor, Lepon ○ (1146,1427) and Tamaron ◉ (1659,1554) fall on integer atlas coordinates; exactly 15 ◉ found (the canon count). 175 candidates, 161 strong. Miss mode: a ring whose hole is broken by a label stroke or road dot is invisible to the detector, so every off-print verdict was read by eye on z5 contact-sheet crops (anchor, markers, rings overlaid). One strong false positive was discarded by eye: the 'o' of 'Heron's House' at (2469,291). Weak candidates (<97%) inside catchments (Bard's Hollow 795,216; Hazad 1388,1074; Haedi 3050,1445; Lepon 1128,1413) are letter bowls by eye. Approaches: segCircleHits, angDelta, mergeAngles, cityApproaches, buildApprPolys and footR extracted verbatim from maps-site/index.html and run in node over party-route.json, named-ways.json (land) and sea-lanes.json (sea) at R=2.5*FOOT_R; compass degrees (0=N, clockwise); calibrated against the table's Drāmūz row (land 257.8, sea 136.7 reproduced). Verdict vocabulary from gap-anchor:C2 (move / keep / owner call); 'keep' here is qualified per row. No data file was edited.

cityCanvasSha_rebaseline.scope: Unchanged: tools/mobile-capture.js descends exactly ['Tamaron','Sokundo','Kanae'] and every docs/mobile/captures baseline hashes city_canvas keys Kanae, Sokundo, Tamaron only. None of the eight new off-print verdicts (Shengo, Pomos, Ishin, Pish, Ītor Hāspira, Ūmak-nūs-Ion, Kolens, Sjefenhold, plus Paril) is hashed, and none feeds the trio's plans. All three hashed cities now have verified 'move' verdicts with coordinates: Tamaron (table, ◉ ring (1659,1554), marker (1659,1556)), Sokundo (1478,1450), Kanae (1523,1490).
cityCanvasSha_rebaseline.precondition_1_convention: Pick ONE point convention before the B0 cut. sampleCityMask does Math.round((a.atlasX-1.35*rW)*2), so ring centre, census-marker (ring-(1,0), ◉ ring+(0,2)) and anchor (ring-(1,1)) conventions each give a different window and hash. The choice also changes visible gates: Tamaron sea set is [319.3,1.6] at the ring centre, [323.4,1.1] at the marker, but [317.7,113.6,3.5] at ring-(1,1); Shengo (not hashed) gets two sea gates or none on a 0.2-0.4 px graze of lane:The South Lane. Cutting B0 before the marker-anchor-pixel-bias convention ruling means a re-cut.
cityCanvasSha_rebaseline.precondition_2_sea_fields: Sokundo sea {WSW,2}, Kanae {E,5} (city-anchors and city-traits) were recorded at the old points; genCityCanvas biases the waterfront to the lane bearing nearest the stored sea side and falls back to the compass side. If the sea fields are re-measured after the move, that is a further hash change: re-measure in the same edit as the move, or freeze them explicitly.
cityCanvasSha_rebaseline.precondition_3_markers: Sokundo and Kanae (and Shengo) have no maps_markers.json entry, so a by-name derivation tool cannot move them. Either the census adds their markers first or the tool carries hand overrides.
cityCanvasSha_rebaseline.ordering: Census second pass should land BEFORE or WITH the anchor tool, not after: (a) it supplies the markers that let the tool derive Sokundo, Kanae and Shengo; (b) it corrects six off-print trace markers the tool would otherwise copy; (c) its additions do not touch the hashed trio, so landing it does not force a second B0 rebaseline. Only the trio's moves plus the convention choice need the single owner-approved cityCanvasSha recapture (dpr>1 class and the 1x desktop class), held until the Mobile 5-9 atlas lane closes or cut centrally as a declared B0 recapture.
